verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical. Both right-align the text stack (July 29, Sewing Class, For Beginners and the Grove.Online ribbon) but centre the illustration cluster under it, so the column has two different axes. The ribbon floats far below the art, the empty band at the bottom is large, and the text is small at this skyscraper size. A uses the height a little better: its illustration is larger and there are fewer empty bands. B's illustration is smaller and its 'For Beginners' line sits tighter under the headline, so it leaves more empty space at the bottom.
